title: An Artinian local ring is Noetherian with nilpotent maximal ideal
statement: Let $(B,\mathfrak m_B)$ be an Artinian local ring (every descending chain of ideals of $B$ is eventually constant). Then $B$ is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $\mathfrak m_B$ is nilpotent: $\mathfrak m_B^N=0$ for some $N\ge1$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00KH (lemma-Noetherian-dimension-0, line 14364: any Artinian ring is Noetherian of dimension zero) and Lemma Tag 00J8 (lemma-artinian-radical-nilpotent, line 12739: the Jacobson radical of an Artinian ring is nilpotent; for a local ring it is the maximal ideal)
